Name: Bubble Wands
Author: dollynhoevida
Description:
This mod adds 3 bubble wands and 2 bubble solutions that can be used to upgrade them!

Vincent sells them at the Desert Festival every year.

How to get a bubble wand:
[spoiler]
Wooden Bubble Wand can be bought for 100 Calico Eggs.
[/spoiler]
How to unlock bubble solutions:
[spoiler]
Bubble Solution is available for 500 Calico Eggs after you've unlocked the Galaxy Sword.
Prismatic Bubble Solution is available for 500 Calico Eggs after you've collected 2 Prismatic Shards and unlocked the Galaxy Sword.
[/spoiler]
How to upgrade bubble wands:
[spoiler]
Buy a Bubble Solution.
Hold the Bubble Solution and right-click on the Wooden Bubble Wand to upgrade it.
or
Buy a Prismatic Bubble Solution.
Hold the Prismatic Bubble Solution and right-click on the Bubble Wand to upgrade it.
[/spoiler]
You can make bubbles to attack enemies (bubbles are stronger than slashing with the wand).

Bubbles made with a Bubble Wand or Prismatic Bubble Wand can bounce when they hit walls.
